spans.s: gūḍha-jāla-bandha (CITD), probably, the style of a verse with an artificial arrangement of the letters.
gūḍha-maṇḍapa (HA), an adjacent hall; hall in front of the sanctum, where devotees carry on worship, etc.
Gūḍha-puruṣa (HD), an officer of the secret service. See Ep. Ind., Vol. XXII, p. 156.
